subject: Post-demo MAP: technical qualification & benchmark milestones
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Alex Porter <alex.porter@healthledger.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-23T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Post-demo MAP: technical qualification & benchmark milestones

Alex — thanks for a productive demo today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single source of truth for the MAP milestone covering technical evaluation. I captured the items we discussed and a suggested timeline in the attached MAP draft (MAP_HealthLedger_v0.9.xlsx). High level: 

- Goal: Validate Redwood inference stack can meet HealthLedger's latency and cost targets for the clinical summarization workload at ~2k tokens/session.
- Proposed success criteria (preliminary): p50 <= 120ms, p95 <= 380ms for 2048 context; end-to-end cost target <= $0.25 per 1k output tokens for steady-state production.
- Model shortlist: RedTeam-Chat-70B-quant (recommended variant), Llama-2-70B-chat (8-bit), and RW-internal trimmed 13B as a low-cost fallback.
- Benchmarks to run: 1) latency distribution (p50/p95/p99), 2) throughput at 100 and 250 concurrent sessions, 3) quality spot-check vs. 50 clinical prompt templates (we'll provide seed prompts).

Proposed owners & timeline:
- HealthLedger provides seed prompt set and 10 representative test records by 2026-05-28 — owner: Alex/Maya
- Redwood to run bench matrix + initial cost estimates by 2026-06-04 — owner: Ben Carter (SE)
- Joint readout + go/no-go decision by 2026-06-08 (internal execs cc'd if we hit blockers) — owner: Rachel Kim

Dependencies: access to a representative dataset (PII redacted), mock auth to exercise request sizes, and approval for a short dedicated test window on Redwood Dedicated (2–3 hours).

Please confirm the timeline and whether HealthLedger can deliver the seed prompts by 5/28. I attached the benchmark_specification_20260523.md with the exact metrics we'll measure and a CSV with our initial cost sensitivity estimates (redwood-performance-estimates.csv).

Thanks,
Rachel
Rachel Kim | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0192
redwood.com

Attachment stubs: MAP_HealthLedger_v0.9.xlsx (xlsx), benchmark_specification_20260523.md (md), redwood-performance-estimates.csv (csv)
From: Alex Porter <alex.porter@healthledger.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Maya Singh <maya.singh@healthledger.com>, eng-team@healthledger.com
Date: 2026-05-24T09:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo MAP: technical qualification & benchmark milestones

Thanks Rachel — this looks good and aligns with what we want. A couple of clarifications from our side: 

1) On the model shortlist: can Redwood confirm that the recommended 'RedTeam-Chat-70B-quant' will be run with KV cache enabled and whether the 8-bit path for Llama-2 will require any additional tuning from our side?
2) Cost target: $0.25/1k output tokens is aggressive; can you include a sensitivity table for tokenization differences (clinical text tends to tokenize differently)?
3) Seed data: we'll deliver 50 redacted records + the 50 prompt templates by EOD 2026-05-28. We will need an NDA addendum for sample data processing — I asked Legal and will loop back.

We can approve a 3-hour Dedicated slot next week once we see the benchmark spec.

—Alex
Alex Porter | Head of Product, HealthLedger
alex.porter@healthledger.com
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Alex Porter <alex.porter@healthledger.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-24T11:06:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo MAP: technical qualification & benchmark milestones

Alex — quick answers inline and an ask for the seed bundle format.

- KV cache: yes, we'll run the 70B quant variant with KV cache active; we'll capture cold vs warm cache P50/P95 in the benchmark matrix.
- 8-bit Llama-2: typically no action required on your side; we'll run a short calibration pass to tune dispatch (we may ask for a small validation set of 10 examples).
- Tokenization sensitivity: attached csv includes three tokenization scenarios (clinical verbose, clinical concise, mixed). I'll expand that into a sensitivity table in the shared drive doc.

Two small asks: 1) please provide seed data as NDJSON or CSV with columns: case_id, prompt_template, expected_length_estimate; 2) confirm whether PHI is fully redacted or if we should expect pseudonymized IDs. This affects how we log samples during the benchmark (we can run in a private test environment to avoid storing any raw PHI).

I'll schedule the Dedicated slot request for 2026-06-02 10:00–13:00 PT tentatively (we'll only use 2–3 hours but want a buffer). If that window works for HealthLedger, let me know and I'll lock it with infra.

Ben Carter | Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
